verdict.rationale: Neon documents a Management API (v2) with an LLM-addressed index of every endpoint and a live OpenAPI spec. Its docs say project creation, configuration and cleanup are fully automated through the API, and the first-party MCP server's 113 tools reach across projects, branches, snapshots, compute, Auth, Data API, Functions and Storage. Neon never explicitly claims API/UI parity, and UI-specific features such as the SQL Editor's AI assistance have no documented API equivalent. missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement that console actions are fully exposed via the API, evidence that UI-only features (e.g. SQL Editor AI) have API equivalents, independent hands-on confirmation of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Platforms can manage tens of thousands (in some cases, millions) of projects programmatically through the Neon API. Project creation, configuration, and cleanup are fully automated
# Neon Management API / Base URL: https://console.neon.tech/api/v2 / Auth: `Authorization: Bearer $NEON_API_KEY`
The hosted Neon MCP Server exposes a 113-tool surface ("Tools preview: 113 enabled") spanning the whole platform
